name: What is the typical lifespan of a casement window?
description: Casement window lifespan varies by material and maintenance, often 20-50+ years. Proper installation is key for maximizing longevity and performance.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of a casement window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a casement window depends significantly on its material, quality of installation, and how well it's maintained. High-quality vinyl windows can last 20-40 years, while fiberglass and wood windows can often exceed 30-50 years with proper care. Regular cleaning, lubricating the operating mechanisms, and ensuring seals remain intact can extend the life of your windows. A professional installation, like those performed by Hometelligent Inc., is crucial for maximizing longevity and performance.
